children: Raiffeisen Bank International shares are headed for their worst daily performance in over four years after the publication of a short-seller report over its business in Russia, which has been disputed by the Austrian bank.
Shares were recently down 8.9% in Europe, on track for their biggest loss since early 2022, when markets turned volatile after Russia's invasion of Ukraine.
